description: ZALF publishes European Union soil, land-use and socioeconomic indicators at NUTS 2 regional level for 2005–2023. The collection connects population change, deprivation and land tenure with soil threats including erosion, compaction and pollution. Its BonaRes detail page identifies the resource and CC BY terms; registry metadata specifies CC BY 4.0 with CSV, XLSX and File Geodatabase distributions. The freely reusable indicators can define regional context and parameter contrasts in land-management and agricultural-infrastructure simulations. Administrative aggregates have limited local detail, and source-dependent indicator dates should be retained when comparing years. The dataset does not directly represent individual soil profiles or engineering assets. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
name: Soil indicators and socio-demographic-economic context: A dataset for the European Union
